## Report Issue

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)

- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

72 BPM, Gong mode pentatonic scale with elegant traditional Chinese harmonic extensions. Calm, spacious, and misty throughout, carrying a gentle ancient oriental warmth. The mood deepens in the mid-section and fades into empty tranquility at the end. Perfect for late-night creation, quiet study, rainy day relaxation, and peaceful meditation. Minimalist ancient Chinese bedroom production texture: warm rice-paper tonal quality, faint residual flute reverb, lingering guqin overtones, subtle wind and rain ambient noise, soft and transparent low-pass mix, highly negative-space arrangement, delivering healing, serene, and timeless oriental atmosphere.
Vocal Details: Vocal Performance
Warm, ethereal, and gentle oriental female vocal style. Soft half-sung half-whispered delivery, intimate and transparent in the mix, with relaxed elongated phrasing that embodies classic ancient charm. Long, soothing breath control. Layered subtle background harmonies with delicate traditional vocal ornament accents, blended with guzheng reverb and vast landscape spatial delay. Large empty instrumental segments with no vocals, relying entirely on ambient texture to convey emotion, creating a tender and tranquil aura.
Arrangement: Song Structure & Instrumentation
Ultra-minimal traditional Chinese rhythm: slow wooden block beats, soft rain-like delicate drum taps, unrushed and stress-free groove. Warm guqin as the foundational harmonic bed, elegant long-tone bamboo flute, ethereal guzheng arpeggios, sporadic pipa pluck embellishments, with constant subtle wind and rain ambient texture throughout the track.
Intro: Wind and rain ambience fades in slowly, guqin overtones unfold gently, bamboo flute enters softly with zero rigid rhythm, building vast empty space.
Verse: Extremely minimal instrumentation, grounded by warm guqin and soft rain percussion, scattered pipa ornaments, relying on lyrical imagery and negative space to shape mood.
Instrumental Break: Bamboo flute and guzheng take turns delivering melodic phrases, layered with sustained spatial reverb to paint misty landscape imagery, with persistent wind ambience.
Bridge: All rhythmic elements drop out, leaving only rain, wind texture and floating detuned guqin tones in pure blank serenity, before the gentle beat eases back in.
Outro: All instrumental layers fade out one by one, ending solely with lingering wind ambience and a final decaying guqin overtone for an empty, peaceful finish.

## MiniMax Music 3

A music generation model by MiniMax that creates complete songs up to 5 minutes long with stable structure and high audio quality. Two inputs drive it: **Caption** (structured music description: style, mood, vocals, arrangement) and **Lyrics** (with `[intro]` `[verse]` `[chorus]` `[bridge]` `[outro]` tags controlling song structure).

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| Caption | Music description. Write it in three sections — Global Metadata → Vocal Details → Arrangement. The more specific, the closer the result. |
| Lyrics | Song lyrics + section tags. Tags are the only executable structural instructions; the lyric text itself only conveys mood. |
| max_duration | Target song length in seconds (default 120 = 2 minutes; the model supports up to ~300 s / 5 minutes). Longer songs take more time and VRAM. |
| seed | Random seed for the generation. Keep it fixed to reproduce the same song; change it to get a different take. |
| Model files | diffusion model / text encoder / VAE.|
| Tiled decode | Decode the audio VAE in overlapping tiles to drastically cut VRAM usage — helpful for long songs on low-VRAM GPUs. Slightly slower, with a small risk of seams at tile boundaries; turn it off on high-VRAM GPUs for the best quality. |

### Prompt Writing Guide

You can find an official [Music Caption Rewriter Skill here](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-Music3)
